plugin.name: File Redaction
plugin.description: Inspect sensitive information, generate desensitized copies, and restore with recovery packages.
view.main.name: File Redaction
tool.desensitize_preview.desc: Preview which sensitive items in a project file would be redacted (read-only, creates no file). Use when the user wants to preview what sensitive information in a file would be redacted.
tool.desensitize_redact.desc: Redact sensitive information in a project file and save it as a NEW redacted copy; the original is never overwritten. Use when the user asks to redact, anonymize or mask a file (mask mode, not restorable).
